The pale shades hardly showed at all on my skin, and even after reapplying the shadow multiple times, couldn't tell anything was on my eyes. There were a couple bronze colors in the palette that were pretty and showed well, but they weren't worth keeping the whole palette. The makeup was cheap so I didn't expect much out of it; I consider this a lesson learned. If you're looking for quality

claims.text: Many customers report that the eyeshadow colors arrived broken or shattered, often making a mess in the packaging.
Several reviewers mention the product is smaller than expected or looks smaller than pictured.
Some customers note slow or lengthy delivery times, though a few say it arrived earlier than expected.
A number of reviewers consider it good value for the low price, with decent pigmentation and useful shades.
A few customers report missing shades or palettes and say the seller would not fix the issue.
